```{r}
# normal graph
ggplot(data, aes(x=Year, y =Exports)) + 
  geom_line(color = 'blue') +
  labs(
    title = 'Central African Republic: Exports (1960-2017)',
    x = 'Year',
    y = 'Exports'
  ) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", linewidth = 1, fill = NA))
```
```{r}
# ACF and PACF

acf(data$Exports, main = 'ACF of Exports')
pacf(data$Exports, main = 'PACF of Exports')

# ACF 
  # not stationary 
    # slow gradual decay of ACF
      # start at 1 and takes many lags to get to 0 
      # has a long tail 
  # need for differencing 
    # want constant mean and variance over time 
    # stabilise variance of time series 
    # stabilising mean necessary to remove changes in level of time series 
      # eliminate trend and seasonality 
    # model cannot learn stable relationship with inconsistent mean 


```
```{r}
# estimating best lambda 

lambda <- BoxCox.lambda(data$Exports)
lambda # -0.3650884

data_bc <- data.frame(
  Year = data$Year,
  Exports = BoxCox(data$Exports, lambda)
  )
ggplot(data_bc, aes(x=Year, y =Exports)) + 
  geom_line(color = 'blue') +
  labs(
    title = 'CAF Exports with Box-Cox (lambda ~ -0.365)',
    x = 'Year',
    y = 'Exports Box-Cox Tranformed'
  ) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", linewidth = 1, fill = NA))

# this isn't necessary
# acf(BoxCox(data$Exports, lambda), main = 'ACF of Box-Cox Tranformed Exports')
# pacf(BoxCox(data$Exports, lambda), main = 'PACF of Box-Cox Tranformed Exports')

# Box-Cox eval 
  # smoother and more linear-looking
  # variance roughly constant 
  # log-like transformation compresses high values 
  # 
```


```{r}

diff_data <- ts(data_bc$Exports, start = min(data_bc$Year), frequency = 1)

diff_data <- diff(diff_data, differences = 1)

plot(diff_data, ylab = 'Difference = 1 After Box-Cox', xlab = 'Year')

  

acf(diff_data, main = 'ACF of Exports (1st difference)')
pacf(diff_data, main = 'PACF of Exports (1st difference)')

# differencing plot 
  # The fluctuation around zero suggests that trend has been removed and the mean is constant 
  # no slow upward/downward movement meaning that one difference is sufficien
  # acf
    # Almost drops straight to zero after lag 1, and tiny insignificant lags remain 
  # pacf
    # large negative spike at 1 
    # everything else inside the band 
  # stationary
  
```

```{r}
# candidate ARIMA models


ts_data <- ts(data$Exports, start = min(data$Year), frequency = 1)

mod_ma0 <- Arima(ts_data, order = c(0,1,0), lambda = 'auto', biasadj = TRUE) # Random walk, MA(0)
mod_ma1 <- Arima(ts_data, order = c(0,1,1), lambda = 'auto', biasadj = TRUE) # ARIMA(0,1,1), MA(1)
mod_ar1 <- Arima(ts_data, order = c(1,1,0), lambda = 'auto', biasadj = TRUE) # ARIMA(1,1,0), AR(1)

print(mod_ma0)
print(mod_ma1)
print(mod_ar1)

arima_eq <- function (model){
  coefs <- model$coef
  sigma2 <- model$sigma2 
  
  cat("Model Equation:\n")
  cat("Y_t=")
  
  if ("intercept" %in% names(coefs)) {
    cat(paste0(" ", round(coefs["intercept"], 4)))
  } else if ("mean" %in% names(coefs)) {
    cat(paste0(" ", round(coefs["mean"], 4)))
  } else {
    cat(" 0")
  }
  
  ar_terms <- grep("^ar", names(coefs))
  for (i in ar_terms) {
    cat(paste0(" + ", round(coefs[i], 4), " * Y_{t-", sub("ar", "", names(coefs)[i]), "}"))
  }
  
  ma_terms <- grep("^ma", names(coefs))
  for (i in ma_terms) {
    cat(paste0(" + ", round(coefs[i], 4), " * e_{t-", sub("ma", "", names(coefs)[i]), "}"))
  }
  
  cat(paste0(" + e_t,  where  e_t ~ N(0, ", round(sigma2, 4), ")\n\n"))
}

arima_eq(mod_ma0)
arima_eq(mod_ma1)
arima_eq(mod_ar1)

```

```{r}
res_ma0 <- residuals(mod_ma0)
res_ma1 <- residuals(mod_ma1)
res_ar1 <- residuals(mod_ar1)

std_res_ma0 <- res_ma0/ sqrt(mod_ma0$sigma2)

par(mfrow = c(1,3))

plot(std_res_ma0, type = "l", main = "Standardized Residuals for MA(0)",
     ylab = "Standardized Residuals", xlab = "Time")

acf(res_ma0, main = "ACF of Residuals for MA(0)")

pvals <- sapply(1:20, function(i) Box.test(res_ma0, lag = i, type = "Ljung-Box")$p.value)

plot(1:20, pvals, type = "b", pch = 19,
     main = "Ljung-Box Test p-values for MA(0)",
     xlab = "Lag", ylab = "p-value")
abline(h = 0.05, col = "blue", lty = 2)



```

```{r}

fc_data <- forecast(mod_ar1, h = 5)
autoplot(fc_data) + 
  labs(
    title = "Forecast with 80% and 95% Confidence Intervals",
    x = 'Year',
    y = 'Export'
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", linewidth = 1, fill = NA))


str(fc_data$level)

forecasted_yrs <- as.integer(time(fc_data$mean))

forecasted_df <- data.frame( 
  Year = forecasted_yrs,
  Forecast = as.numeric(fc_data$mean)
  )

print(forecasted_df)

forecasted_df <- cbind(
  forecasted_df,
  Lo_80 = as.numeric(fc_data$lower[,1]),
  Hi_80 = as.numeric(fc_data$upper[,1]),
  Lo_95 = as.numeric(fc_data$lower[,2]),
  Hi_95 = as.numeric(fc_data$upper[,2])
)

print(forecasted_df)
```
